title: Indiana University students and locals protest sexual violence

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against sexual violence on campus following an alleged assault case at Cornell University.
tea.want: Participants spoke out against sexual assault and raised awareness of campus safety issues during the high-risk 'Red Zone' period.
tea.changed: Oct 16: Over 50 students and community members gathered at Sample Gates for the demonstration.

summary: Indiana University students and Bloomington locals gathered for a demonstration at Sample Gates to protest campus sexual violence. Organised by a local anonymous Instagram account called 'We are Jane Doe,' the protest was prompted by an alleged rape case at Cornell University involving a student known as Jane Doe. Attendees and organizers spoke out about campus safety during the 'Red Zone' period between the beginning of the semester and Thanksgiving Break. According to reports cited in sources, the Indiana University Police Department received numerous reports of sexual violence earlier in the semester.
demands: Raise awareness about campus sexual violence
Address sexual assault risks during the Red Zone
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Over 50 students and community members gathered in front of Sample Gates on Friday afternoon.
